title: Paranormal Activity
description: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night.

title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
description: A vampire hunter (Jason Scott Lee) goes in search of medical students who hope to distill the key to immortality from the body of Dracula.

title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula III - Legacy
description: With help from his partner (Jason Scott Lee), a vampire hunter (Jason London) tries to save his fiancée from the evil count in Romania.

title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
description: A London antiques dealer (Christopher Plummer) travels to New Orleans to save his estranged daughter from his nemesis, Count Dracula (Gerard Butler).

title: Scream
description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
description: A doomed boy stalls a witch (Deborah Harry) with three tales: "Lot 249," "Cat From Hell" and "Lover's Vow."

title: The Brothers Grimm
description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

title: Vanilla Sky
description: A wealthy womanizer (Tom Cruise) has trouble distinguishing dreams from reality after a car accident leaves him disfigured.

title: Shakespeare in Love
description: Young William Shakespeare (Joseph Fiennes) falls for Viola (Gwyneth Paltrow), reawakening his creativity, but she is betrothed to Wessex.

title: Million Dollar Baby
description: A deep bond develops between a cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) and the female boxer (Hilary Swank) he reluctantly takes under his wing.

title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States.

title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

title: Stardust
description: To win the heart of his beloved, a young man (Charlie Cox) ventures into the realm of fairies to retrieve a fallen star (Claire Danes).

title: Cop Land
description: The sheriff (Sylvester Stallone) of a small New Jersey police community confronts key men (Harvey Keitel, Ray Liotta) on both sides of a law-enforcement cover-up.

title: The Score
description: A master thief (Robert De Niro) agrees to work with a volatile partner (Edward Norton) for one last heist before he retires.

title: The Untouchables
description: Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness attempts to take Al Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force.

title: The November Man
description: An ex-CIA agent (Pierce Brosnan) comes out of retirement to protect a valuable witness (Olga Kurylenko) and soon learns that now he is the target of his former friend and protégé (Luke Bracey).

title: Soul Men
description: Old animosities re-emerge when two estranged singers (Samuel L. Jackson, Bernie Mac) travel cross-country to perform in a tribute concert for their late band leader.

title: Tommy Boy
description: A ne'er-do-well auto-parts heir must stop his father's widow from selling the business.

title: Patriot Games
description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

title: Urban Cowboy
description: A Texas farmer (John Travolta) moves to the city, immerses himself in honky-tonk and falls for a sexy cowgirl (Debra Winger).

title: Chocolat
description: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent.

title: The Time Traveler's Wife
description: The unusual genetic makeup of a librarian (Eric Bana) causes him to travel back and forth through time, so that he and his beloved (Rachel McAdams) are always out of sync.

title: Forrest Gump
description: JFK, LBJ, Vietnam, Watergate and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man (Tom Hanks) with an IQ of 75.

title: You've Got Mail
description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

title: Basic Instinct
description: A woman suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick ensnares a San Francisco cop in a web of lust and deceit.

title: The Crow
description: A black bird resurrects a rock musician who then avenges his own murder and his fiancée's.

title: For Greater Glory: The True Story of Cristiada
description: In the 1920s, the Mexican government's attempt to secularize the country sparks a rebellion known as the Cristero War.

title: Three Wishes
description: A frustrated family man recalls an encounter he (Joseph Mazzello), his widowed mom (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio) and his family had with a mysterious vagrant (Patrick Swayze) in 1955 suburbia.

title: Coneheads
description: Stranded on Earth, aliens Beldar and Prymaat of Remulak try suburbia with their teenage daughter, Connie.

title: Up in the Air
description: A corporate downsizing expert (George Clooney) realizes he is developing real feelings for a frequent bedmate (Vera Farmiga) whose cache of travel miles and club cards rivals his own.

title: You Can Count on Me
description: The straight-arrow life of a single mother (Laura Linney) begins to go into a tailspin when her drifter brother (Mark Ruffalo) returns home.

title: He's Just Not That Into You
description: Friends and lovers try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships, sometimes misconstruing the true intentions of the opposite sex.

title: The Terminal
description: Unauthorized to enter the United States, an Eastern European (Tom Hanks) befriends a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones) while living in a New York airport.

title: Top Gun
description: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

title: The King's Speech
description: An extraordinary friendship forms between England's King George VI (Colin Firth) and the Australian actor/speech therapist (Geoffrey Rush) who helps him overcome a stammer.

title: Like Water for Chocolate
description: The youngest daughter (Lumi Cavazos) of a Mexican family expresses her feelings in preparing wonderful food, when tradition keeps her from marrying her true love (Marco Leonardi).

title: Ask the Dust
description: In Depression-era Los Angeles, a fiery Mexican waitress (Salma Hayek) who wants to improve her lot through marriage meets an aspiring writer (Colin Farrell) of Italian descent.

title: Roadracers
description: Police, punks and parents hassle a rock musician (David Arquette) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) in a lame 1950s town.

title: The Mechanic
description: An elite hitman teaches his trade to an apprentice who has a connection to one of his previous victims.

title: Double Jeopardy
description: In an insurance scam, a man fakes his death and sets his wife up to take the blame. After serving 10 years in prison, she sets out to get revenge, immune from the law since she cannot be re-prosecuted for the same crime.

title: Changing Lanes
description: An attorney and a recovering alcoholic have a car accident which swiftly escalates into an ongoing, bitter feud.
